answer: The cheapest real defence: bind each identity to one scarce resource bought at market price, because shale only stays cheap while the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while payout per identity stays flat. Concretely, island is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any ledge approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
